title: lovebyte.exe
description:
Your kamioshi's stream abruptly ends one day & his silence creates rampant rumors. Avoiding the online toxicity, you join a degenerate group chat where VTuber fans chat about their oshis freely. But you start noticing strange coincidences - is your kamioshi in this chat? 

In this dating chatsim, who's real & who's pretending in chat?

lovebyte.exe : inspired by Mystic Messenger, VTubers, and internet spam

Game Features

🎙️ Unlock voice-acted scenes from real VTubers such as Roy Chiato, Banzoin Hakka, RiiKami, Kaine Knight, Bluebell, and rachie.

📸 Unlock delulu & parasocial content and CGs across different channels, including streams and discord chats

🎨 Customize your in-game Discord profile & desktop

🔎 Sift through fake surveys, sketchy internet downloads, and sus emails in minigames to avoid scams and earn money to support your kamioshi

🔁 Reveal romanceable characters' irl-selves and explore multiple endings as answer choices matter!

Romanceable Characters

• Piece together the identities of 6 romanceable characters:

• MINK!! Mochaberry

• Solo Lightracer

• WizardPit

• Dolphin Daddy

• Pochima

• Forever 🐸 Frog

Game Features

• Sift through fake surveys, sketchy internet downloads, and sus emails in minigames that blur the line between truth and scam. Can you tell what is real?

• Unlockable CGs, discord voice calls, DMs, and more

• Customizable MC

• Unlockable Achievements

• Multiple Endings
description_short: A chat dating sim game inspired by Mystic Messenger, VTuber communities, and internet spam
